trigger.Name: StartFadeEffect
trigger.script:
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
EnableGodMode()
Fly("start_game", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 0.1, 0, 1) StartCinematic() UpdateCinematic( 1 )
AddCinematicMessage(77773, 0)
TActivate("trSilenceMusic") TActivate("StartFadeEffect_End")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: StartFadeEffect_End
trigger.script:
RestoreAllToleranceStatus() DisableGodMode() StopPlayingCustomMusic()
local player_car = GetVar("PlayerCar").AsString
local vehP = GetPlayerVehicle() local PlfCoor = vehP:GetPosition() if vehP then if player_car == "Bug" then CreateEffectTTLed("ET_S_ENGINE_BUG_STARTING", PlfCoor, Quaternion(0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000), 1538) elseif player_car == "Molokovoz" then CreateEffectTTLed("ET_S_ENGINE_MOLOKOVOZ_STARTING", PlfCoor, Quaternion(0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000), 1142) elseif player_car == "Ural" then CreateEffectTTLed("ET_S_ENGINE_URAL_STARTING", PlfCoor, Quaternion(0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000), 1272) elseif player_car == "Belaz" then CreateEffectTTLed("ET_S_ENGINE_BELAZ"..random(2).."_STARTING", PlfCoor, Quaternion(0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000), 3200) elseif player_car == "Mirotvorec" or player_car == "hunterChassis_Scav" then CreateEffectTTLed("ET_S_ENGINE_MIROTVOREC_STARTING", PlfCoor, Quaternion(0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000), 923) elseif player_car == "Cruiser" or player_car == "scoutChassis_Scav" then CreateEffectTTLed("ET_S_ENGINE_CRUISER_STARTING", PlfCoor, Quaternion(0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000), 930) elseif player_car == "fighterChassis_Scav" then CreateEffectTTLed("ET_S_ENGINE_FIGHTER_STARTING", PlfCoor, Quaternion(0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000), 1601) end end
if GetVar("SpawnPlayer").AsInt == 1 then if GetVar("PlayerBelong").AsString == "SCAV" then AddFadingMsgByStrIdFormatted("fm_player_search_exit_zone", "Exits2LocationR1M1_ForScav") else AddFadingMsgByStrIdFormatted("fm_player_search_exit_zone", "Exits2LocationR1M1") end else if GetVar("PlayerBelong").AsString == "SCAV" then AddFadingMsgByStrIdFormatted("fm_player_search_exit_zone", "Exits1LocationR1M1_ForScav") else AddFadingMsgByStrIdFormatted("fm_player_search_exit_zone", "Exits1LocationR1M1") end end
TActivate("MessageRaid") TActivate("TimerRaidStart") TActivate("CreatePMC") if not(GetVar("PlayerBelong").AsString == "SCAV") then TActivate("IfRaidCountForQuest") end TActivate("ShowExits_Activate")
AllowSave(false)
SetCameraBehindPlayerVehicle()
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutTimeRaid
trigger.script:
local Plf = GetPlayerVehicle() local PlfID = GetPlayerVehicleId() local PlfCoor = Plf:GetPosition() PlfCoor.y = PlfCoor.y + 25*0.74 PlfCoor.z = PlfCoor.z + 25*0.74
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL) EnableGodMode()
Plf:SetCustomLinearVelocity(0) Plf:SetThrottle(0)
FlyAround(1, 0, 15, 7, PlfCoor, PlfID, 1, 1) StartCinematic() UpdateCinematic(1)
AddCinematicMessage(1,0)
TActivate("cutTimeRaid_End") TDeactivate("IfChargeCar") if not(GetVar("PlayerBelong").AsString == "SCAV") then TActivate("IfPlayerDieForQuest") end
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutTimeRaid_End
trigger.script:
RestoreAllToleranceStatus() DisableGodMode()
local pl = GetPlayerVehicle() if not(GetVar("PlayerBelong").AsString == "SCAV") then local spec = pl:GetPartByName("BASKET_SPECIAL_ITEMS") pl:TakeOffAllGuns() if spec then spec:Remove() end TActivate("trUpdateCabinAndBasket") else if pl then pl:SetSkin(-1) end if 1.5 >= GetTolerance(1100, 1082) then SetVar("ScavCarma", GetVar("ScavCarma").AsString - 0.4) end end
TActivate("ExitFadeEffect")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trUpdateCabinAndBasket
trigger.script:
local plf = GetPlayerVehicle() local basket = plf:GetBasket() local basDur = math.floor(basket:GetPropertyById(19).AsFloat + 0.5) local skin = plf:GetSkin() local cabAffix = GetAffixPartByName("CABIN") if cabAffix then AddAffixToPart(plf, "CABIN", cabAffix, nil, 1) else UpdateCab(plf) end
local basAffix = GetAffixPartByName("BASKET") if basAffix then AddAffixToPart(plf, "BASKET", basAffix, nil, 1) else if basket then plf:SetNewPart("BASKET", basket:GetProperty("Prototype").AsString) basket:SetProperty("Durability", basDur) end end
plf:SetSkin(skin)
local AllItems = AllItems() for i = 1, getn(AllItems) do if HasPlayerAmountOfItems(AllItems[i], 1) then for count = 1, GetItemsAmount(AllItems[i]) do RemoveItemsFromPlayerRepository(AllItems[i], 1) end end end trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: FakePlayerDead
trigger.script: TActivate("PlayerCarConfiguration") TActivate("cutPlayerDead") TActivate("DeactivateAllExits") TDeactivate("TimerRaid") TDeactivate("AirDropProbability") TDeactivate("IfChargeCar") if not(GetVar("PlayerBelong").AsString == "SCAV") then TActivate("IfPlayerDieForQuest") end trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutPlayerDead
trigger.script:
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
local pl = GetPlayerVehicle() local plPos = pl:GetPosition() local objid = pl:GetId() if pl then pl:TakeOffAllGuns() pl:SetSkin(-1) pl:setGodMode(1) pl:SetThrottle(0) pl:SetCustomLinearVelocity(0) CreateNewSgNodeObject("ET_PS_VEH_EXP2_MED", "exp01", -1, -1, plPos, Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 1), 1) CreateNewSgNodeObject("ET_PS_VEH_EXP_CAB", "exp02", -1, -1, plPos, Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 1), 1) CreateEffectInsertedInRemove("ET_S_DEATH", plPos, Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 1), true) end
plPos.y = plPos.y + 20 plPos.z = plPos.z + 15 FlyAround(5, 0.5, 15, 10, plPos, objid, 0, 1, "", 0) StartCinematic() UpdateCinematic(1)
RuleConsole("g_postEffect Dead") TActivate("cutPlayerDead_End")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutPlayerDead_End
trigger.script:
RestoreAllToleranceStatus()
for i=1,2 do local fx = getObj("exp0"..i) if fx then fx:Remove() end end
if GetVar("PlayerCar").AsString == "Molokovoz" then AddPlayerNewVehicle("MolokovozChassis") elseif GetVar("PlayerCar").AsString == "Ural" then AddPlayerNewVehicle("UralChassis") elseif GetVar("PlayerCar").AsString == "Belaz" then AddPlayerNewVehicle("BelazChassis") elseif GetVar("PlayerCar").AsString == "Mirotvorec" then AddPlayerNewVehicle("MirotvorecChassis") elseif GetVar("PlayerCar").AsString == "Cruiser" then AddPlayerNewVehicle("CruiserChassis") else if GetVar("PlayerBelong").AsString ~= "SCAV" then AddPlayerNewVehicle("BugChassis") end end
if GetVar("PlayerBelong").AsString == "SCAV" then local plf = GetPlayerVehicle() if plf then plf:SetSkin(-1) end if 1.5 >= GetTolerance(1100, 1082) then SetVar("ScavCarma", GetVar("ScavCarma").AsString - 0.4) end end
GetPlayerVehicle():setGodMode(1)
RuleConsole("g_postEffect DeadOff") UpdateWeather()
TActivate("ExitFadeEffect")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: ExitFadeEffect
trigger.script:
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL) EnableGodMode()
Fly("start_game", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 0.1, 0, 1) StartCinematic()
AddCinematicMessage(77773, 0)
TActivate("ExitFadeEffect_End") TActivate("ExitToMap")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutExitR4M1
trigger.script:
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
local Plf = GetPlayerVehicle() Plf:SetThrottle(0) Plf:SetCustomLinearVelocity(0) Plf:SetGamePositionOnGround(CVector(3727.149, 343.862, 2805.792)) Plf:SetRotation(Quaternion(-0.010, -0.111, 0.000, 0.994)) Plf:SetExternalPathByName("player_exitR4M1")
local PlfID = GetPlayerVehicleId() local PlfCoor = Plf:GetPosition() PlfCoor.y = PlfCoor.y + 25*0.74 PlfCoor.z = PlfCoor.z + 25*0.74
FlyAround(1, 0, 25, 6, PlfCoor, PlfID, 1, 1) StartCinematic() UpdateCinematic(1)
TActivate("cutExitR4M1_End")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutExitR4M1_End
trigger.script:
RestoreAllToleranceStatus()
local Plf = GetPlayerVehicle() if Plf then Plf:PlaceToEndOfPath("player_exitR4M1") Plf:SetGamePositionOnGround(CVector(3719.013, 343.507, 2849.400)) Plf:SetRotation(Quaternion(-0.011, -0.054, 0.001, 0.998)) end
SetCameraBehindPlayerVehicle()
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: FadeEffectIfScavCarFollowRemove
trigger.script:
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
Fly("start_game", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 0.1, 0, 1) StartCinematic()
AddCinematicMessage(77773, 0)
local vehPlayer = GetPlayerVehicle() if vehPlayer then vehPlayer:SetThrottle(0) vehPlayer:SetCustomLinearVelocity(0) end
TActivate("FadeEffectIfScavCarFollowRemove_End") trigger:Deactivate()
